[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the First Amendment to Outline Agreement 4600006476 with Montgomery Hardware Company: To extend the term by two (2) years, for new expiration date of April 29, 2029, and increase the contract authority by $300,000, for new total not to exceed $750,000, covering supply and delivery of doors, frames, and hardware for Los Angeles World Airports (Daniel Hughes)
